verdict.rationale: Segment shows some at-scale, many-record processing. Reverse ETL syncs warehouse query results in bulk to third-party destinations, and Audiences group many users and sync them to hundreds of destinations. However, the Public API is documented only as per-resource CRUD with pagination and rate limits, with no explicit batch or bulk-edit operations. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints, bulk edit/delete across many sources, destinations or profiles, agent-oriented bulk workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
